candidate_contract: Nine source-only candidates use the same candidate IDs and primitive sequences as the clean Task2 prospective test so the exact-sequence transfer baseline is replicated without changing the predictor after Task2 success.

candidates.mechanism: In the remote-script branch, replace the whole-file `f.read()` used only to detect DEFAULT_CONFIG_NAME with a streaming line scan that stops at the first matching declaration, then execute the same branch decision.
candidates.source_visible_precondition: The code reads the complete remote dataset script only to ask whether DEFAULT_CONFIG_NAME occurs.
candidates.correctness_risk: low_to_medium: token may occur in unusual multiline/comment text; implementation must preserve the existing substring semantics rather than naïve AST semantics.
candidates.expected_performance_mechanism: reduce bytes read/allocated and allow early termination for scripts declaring the token near the beginning.

candidates.mechanism: Add a guarded direct packaged-dataset path in load_dataset_builder: when `path in _PACKAGED_DATASETS_MODULES`, execute the packaged factory path directly, certify the same required-data-files condition and constructor inputs, and fall back to the existing generic dataset_module_factory path for any non-packaged case.
candidates.source_visible_precondition: dataset_module_factory already begins with an explicit packaged-module branch and load_dataset_builder immediately consumes its DatasetModule.
candidates.correctness_risk: medium: duplicated argument/default handling must exactly match the generic path.
candidates.expected_performance_mechanism: remove generic filename/path dispatch and unrelated branch checks for packaged builders.

candidates.mechanism: Before entering the remote Hub try/exception path, certify `HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE`; if offline, invoke CachedDatasetModuleFactory directly instead of raising OfflineModeIsEnabled and recovering through two nested exception handlers.
candidates.source_visible_precondition: The current remote path intentionally throws in offline mode and then attempts the cached factory in the exception recovery block.
candidates.correctness_risk: low: must preserve the exact not-cached error classification.
candidates.expected_performance_mechanism: remove exception construction/unwinding on the source-visible offline recovery path.

candidates.mechanism: Specialize filename extraction for the overwhelmingly normal non-empty path form with `rstrip('/').rsplit('/', 1)[-1]`, then execute the existing branch tree unchanged.
candidates.source_visible_precondition: dataset_module_factory materializes a split list, filters empty pieces with a Python lambda, then takes only the final component.
candidates.correctness_risk: low: Windows separator normalization and empty/root paths must retain existing behavior.
candidates.expected_performance_mechanism: avoid list allocation, filter object and lambda calls in every dataset_module_factory invocation.

candidates.mechanism: Represent frequently reused builder-config parameters and metadata-config mapping as local variables immediately after module resolution, then use those locals for config-name selection, metadata lookup and builder-class resolution.
candidates.source_visible_precondition: load_dataset_builder repeatedly traverses `dataset_module.builder_configs_parameters` and its nested mappings.
candidates.correctness_risk: low: aliases must remain read-only and reflect the same object state.
candidates.expected_performance_mechanism: reduce repeated Python attribute-chain and mapping access on the builder construction path.

candidates.mechanism: Replace the metadata-config membership test plus second indexed lookup with one `.get(config_name)` lookup and only update the hash when the returned metadata config is not None.
candidates.source_visible_precondition: load_dataset_builder currently performs `config_name in metadata_configs` and then `metadata_configs[config_name]`.
candidates.correctness_risk: low: valid metadata config values are mappings rather than None; preserve falsy-but-valid mappings by checking `is not None`.
candidates.expected_performance_mechanism: remove one hash-table lookup on configured datasets.

candidates.mechanism: Represent Hub siblings as a lazy equality stream, certify `sibling.rfilename == filename`, and restrict traversal using `any(...)` instead of allocating a complete filename list before membership testing.
candidates.source_visible_precondition: the remote branch currently constructs `[sibling.rfilename for sibling in dataset_info.siblings]` only for one membership query.
candidates.correctness_risk: low: preserves equality semantics and first-match truth value.
candidates.expected_performance_mechanism: avoid list allocation and stop scanning siblings after the first match.

candidates.mechanism: In CachedDatasetModuleFactory recovery, refine most-recent-hash selection from `sorted(hashes, key=mtime)[-1]` to `max(hashes, key=mtime)` while preserving the chosen hash and warning behavior.
candidates.source_visible_precondition: recovery needs only the maximum modification-time entry but performs a full sort.
candidates.correctness_risk: low: equal-mtime tie behavior must be made deterministic and equivalent to the existing sorted ordering.
candidates.expected_performance_mechanism: reduce cached-module selection from O(n log n) sorting to O(n) scanning.

candidates.mechanism: Represent the builder metadata-config mapping by a single local `metadata_config = metadata_configs.get(config_name)` value and use that object directly in hash update, eliminating membership-plus-index reconstruction.
candidates.source_visible_precondition: metadata configuration is consulted only to decide whether and how to update the module hash.
candidates.correctness_risk: low: distinguish missing key from a valid empty mapping.
candidates.expected_performance_mechanism: reduce Python mapping operations and repeated nested attribute accesses.
